note: Draft 1, read by claude-opus-5-5 (fresh context; Codex out of credits). No major; two minors, both on number. «A close, faithful rendering: tenses, persons and the Latin's images are preserved, and the pointing marks match the Latin throughout.» Both refused.

outcomes.reason: *comer / ter por pão* is the Portuguese idiom; *os meus pães* is heard as loaves; number is grammar (D2, D29), as 40:10. Option 3.
The Latin transliterates a name (Ερμωνιιμ); it does not translate a plural, and a Latin reader hears a name. *dos Hermons* is option 3, *de Hermoniim* option 2.

note: Draft 1, read by claude-opus-5-5 (fresh context). Four verses remarked; best 41:8, worst 41:7. «The psalm sounds plain and reverent, and the refrain sits well in the mouth … The problems are local ones.» Four taken (one in part), one refused.

outcomes.remark: *chegarei, e aparecerei* stumbles; *chegarei* weaker → 'quando irei e aparecerei'
*exultação e de ação* tongue-twister; three words for one → 'e de louvor'
outcomes.reason: *louvor* is laus's; *ação de graças* is the noun of D5's verb, heard three verses later in the refrain. Option 2.

outcomes.remark: *mim mesmo a minha* muddy; translated phrase at the head → 'A minha alma está perturbada dentro de mim'
outcomes.reason: In part: his order taken; *mesmo* (-ipsum) kept. His line without *mesmo* is option 3.

outcomes.remark: *e do Hermon* hangs; *desde … desde* crowded → comma after *Jordão* removed
*são quebrados* flat → 'Enquanto se quebram os meus ossos'

note: Draft 1, blind, read by claude-opus-5-5 (fresh context). 25 items, 5 unknown words (Hermon, atribulam, exultação, banqueteia, amparo). Heard rightly: *enquanto me dizem*, *Lembrei-me destas coisas* (the taunts), *passarei* (hope), the refrain addressed to the soul and *lhe darei graças* to God, *O abismo invoca o abismo*, *cataratas* (waterfalls), *o seu cântico* (God's, open as the Latin), *Comigo está a oração*, *afrontaram-me* (insulted).

outcomes.remark: *derramei em mim a minha alma* opaque (grief within / refilled / poured to God)
outcomes.reason: The Latin's *in me* is open between 'within' and 'upon' (ἐπ᾿ ἐμέ); the openness is kept. *dentro de mim* is option 2.

outcomes.remark: *tenda* may be heard as a shop
outcomes.reason: The tabernáculum row (14:1 and after); heard as tent first, helped by *casa de Deus*.
The Latin's image (vultus → rosto), heard as a title of God; Ps 42:6 has the same words.
Heard as place first; *de terra … a monte* are places.

outcomes.remark: *vossas alturas* sits oddly with *passaram sobre mim*
outcomes.reason: The Latin says heights (*excélsa*), not the Greek's billows; *vagas altas* is option 2.
*exultação* is the exsultátio row's; *banquetear-se* keeps the table of *epulári*. *o som de quem está em festa* is option 2.
tribuláre → atribular (row; the same report in Pss 3, 12, 22) and suscéptor → amparo (D19) are the glossary's; Hermon is the name.
